leverage_lenses.idea: Computational closed-loop сейчас stateless. Добавить episodic memory (iteration history) + semantic memory (73bp cluster = HIGH_CONF после 3× confirmations) → cross-locus hypothesis transfer.
leverage_lenses.why_nonobvious: RAG обычно для documents, не для genomic hypothesis iteration. Memory enables reuse подтверждённых patterns (HBB → BRCA1).
leverage_lenses.experiment: Run 5 iterations HBB → tag patterns → adapt to BRCA1. Measure transfer rate (≥30% target).
leverage_lenses.metric: Transfer rate (# adapted hypotheses / total), quality preservation (≥60% transferred hypotheses score ≥20)

leverage_lenses.idea: ARCHCODE = единственный публичный benchmark для 3D-genome models с real falsification tests. Превратить в leaderboard (Task 1: Hi-C correlation, Task 2: Within-category AUC, Task 3: Cross-locus transfer).
leverage_lenses.why_nonobvious: 3D-genome field не имеет shared benchmark (аналог ImageNet). Все публикуют isolated results.
leverage_lenses.experiment: Create benchmark spec, submit ARCHCODE baseline, outreach к 3 labs (Fudenberg, Zhou, Noble). Target: ≥2 external submissions / 6 months.
leverage_lenses.metric: Adoption (# submissions), reproducibility (≥90% users run successfully), citation (≥5 papers / year)

leverage_lenses.idea: 73bp HBB cluster (3× confirmed) = wet-lab validation target. RT-qPCR + Capture Hi-C могут confirm enhancer disruption → первая experimental validation structural blind spot.
leverage_lenses.why_nonobvious: Computational findings обычно остаются computational. Partner с erythroid lab = переход к experimental confirmation.
leverage_lenses.experiment: Partner with lab, prioritize top-5 pearls, run RT-qPCR + allele-specific Capture Hi-C. Target: ≥2/5 validated (40% precision).
leverage_lenses.metric: Validation rate (# experimentally confirmed / tested), effect size (CAGE Δ in wet-lab vs AlphaGenome prediction)

leverage_lenses.idea: Hypothesis generator сейчас rule-based. Добавить falsification-first filter: generate 10 hypotheses → pre-design 3 falsification tests для каждой → rank by testability → run top-3.
leverage_lenses.why_nonobvious: Обычно generate → test. Предлагается generate → design falsification → rank → then test. Falsification-first на уровне generation.
leverage_lenses.experiment: Generate 10 hypotheses, rank by falsifiability, run top-3. Measure testability rate (≥80% target vs 33% baseline).
leverage_lenses.metric: Testability (# runnable with existing data), novelty (LLM-as-Judge ≥0.7), confirmation rate (20-40%)

leverage_lenses.idea: Validation suite сейчас static (30 hand-coded tests). Превратить в self-expanding suite: agent monitors null results → generates regression tests → tracks coverage gaps.
leverage_lenses.why_nonobvious: Test suites обычно static. Self-expanding = agent learns what to falsify next.
leverage_lenses.experiment: Prompt: 'Analyze 30 tests, find coverage gaps, suggest 5 new tests.' Implement top-2. Measure if they reveal new limitations.
leverage_lenses.metric: Suggestion quality (≥60% rated 'valuable'), coverage increase (new mechanisms tested), falsification power (≥1 new null result)

leverage_lenses.idea: ARCHCODE caught own validation theater (AUC 0.977 = artifact). Превратить в general-purpose Validation Theater Detector для genomic ML papers (check: circular AUC, data leakage, matched controls, ablation).
leverage_lenses.why_nonobvious: Most reproducibility tools check code correctness. Предлагается check scientific validity (is claim real or artifact?).
leverage_lenses.experiment: Test on ARCHCODE (known issue: category artifact) + SpliceAI (clean model). Measure: TP rate 100%, FP rate <20%.
leverage_lenses.metric: True positive (flags ARCHCODE issue), false positive (<20% on clean models), novel discoveries (≥1 unreported issue)

hypotheses.text: Research Memory Graph enables cross-locus hypothesis transfer
hypotheses.why: Memory позволяет reuse подтверждённых patterns (73bp cluster) на новых loci. Episodic + semantic memory для genomic context.
hypotheses.test: HBB confirmed hypothesis → adapt to BRCA1, run 5 iterations, measure transfer rate
hypotheses.risk: <risk> HBB-specific bias → false positives на других loci

hypotheses.text: Falsification-first hypothesis generator снижает untestable hypotheses
hypotheses.why: Pre-filter по testability убирает 'beautiful but unverifiable' ideas. Generate → verify → then test.
hypotheses.test: Generate 10, rank by falsifiability, run top-3. Compare vs baseline (rule-based).

hypotheses.text: Foundation Model Benchmark станет leaderboard для 3D-genome models
hypotheses.why: Нет shared benchmark → первый получит adoption. 5 tasks: Hi-C correlation, within-category AUC, cross-locus transfer, ablation, enhancer proximity.
hypotheses.test: Contact 3 labs, publish benchmark spec, baseline submission (ARCHCODE).
hypotheses.metric: ≥2 external submissions / 6 months, ≥90% reproducibility, ≥5 citations / year

hypotheses.text: 73bp HBB cluster = universal promoter vulnerability pattern
hypotheses.why: If mechanism = TATA-box disruption → should replicate across loci with TATA-box.
hypotheses.test: Find TATA-box loci (BRCA1, TP53), search for promoter clusters.

hypotheses.text: Self-expanding validation suite auto-detects coverage gaps
hypotheses.why: Agent monitors null results → suggests regression tests. Tracks coverage: 'tested CTCF shuffle, missing: tissue-specificity'.
hypotheses.test: Prompt for 5 new tests, human eval, implement top-2, run.
hypotheses.metric: ≥60% suggestions rated 'valuable', ≥1 new null result discovered

hypotheses.text: Validation Theater Detector finds artifacts в published models
hypotheses.why: ARCHCODE found own artifact → generalize. Check: circular AUC, data leakage, matched controls, ablation.
hypotheses.test: Run on ARCHCODE (true positive) + SpliceAI (false positive check).
hypotheses.metric: TP rate 100%, FP rate <20%, ≥1 novel finding in external model

hypotheses.text: AlphaGenome ISM fine-tuning improves pearl detection
hypotheses.why: AlphaGenome trained genome-wide → fine-tune на HBB → better CAGE predictions.
hypotheses.test: Fine-tune on 353 HBB variants, compare CAGE Δ before/after.
hypotheses.risk: <risk> Overfitting (N=353 small), no independent validation set

hypotheses.text: Cross-species conservation identifies real pearls vs artifacts
hypotheses.why: Real structural disruption → conserved across human/mouse/chimp. Artifacts → human-only.
hypotheses.test: Align HBB locus across 3 species, check if pearls in conserved regions.
hypotheses.metric: Pearl enrichment in conserved regions p<0.05

hypotheses.text: Computational closed-loop + wet-lab partner = autonomous discovery pipeline
hypotheses.why: Ginkgo proves concept (36K experiments) → ARCHCODE provides in-silico pre-screen.
hypotheses.test: Partner with erythroid lab, closed-loop proposes variants → wet-lab validates top-5.

hypotheses.text: Hypothesis Market allocation finds patterns faster than linear search
hypotheses.why: Parallel exploration + Bayesian resource allocation = MCTS для biology. 10 hypotheses compete for iterations.
hypotheses.test: 10 parallel hypotheses, 30 iteration budget, market reallocation based on p(hypothesis | data).

top3_proposals.formulation: Persistent knowledge graph storing project analyses, hypothesis outcomes, cross-project patterns улучшает hypothesis quality via transfer learning, reducing redundant exploration by ≥20%.
top3_proposals.known: [VERIFIED] computational_closed_loop.py exists (278 lines), confirmed 73bp cluster (15/20 pearls), но stateless.
top3_proposals.unknown: <hypothesis> Can hypotheses transfer across domains? ARCHCODE genomics → TeraG NLP?
top3_proposals.experiment: 1. Run 7-pass на 3 projects (ARCHCODE, ChernoffPy, ContextProof). 2. Extract hypotheses → populate graph. 3. Semantic similarity (sentence-transformers). 4. Transfer test: ARCHCODE → TeraG, retrieve top-3 similar hypotheses. 5. Measure transfer rate.
top3_proposals.baseline: Stateless prompt: 0% transfer (each project analyzed independently)
top3_proposals.metrics: Transfer rate ≥20%, quality preservation ≥60% (score ≥20), redundancy <10%, outcome prediction AUC ≥0.65
top3_proposals.risks: <risk> HBB bias → false positives. <hypothesis> BRCA1 architecture ≠ HBB. <risk> Memory bloat (1000s iterations).
top3_proposals.safety: [CLEARED] Computational only, stores project metadata (no PII, no secrets)

top3_proposals.formulation: Shared, falsification-first benchmark для 3D-genome contact prediction и variant interpretation models улучшает reproducibility, выявляет validation theater, ускоряет field-wide progress.
top3_proposals.known: [VERIFIED] ARCHCODE имеет 30 falsification tests, 30,318 variants, 9 loci, Hi-C validation (r=0.28-0.59).
top3_proposals.unknown: <unknown> Согласятся ли Akita/Orca authors submit? Есть ли ресурсы для maintenance?
top3_proposals.experiment: Phase 1 (2 weeks): 1. Create archcode-benchmark repo. 2. Document 5 tasks (Hi-C, within-category, cross-locus, ablation, enhancer). 3. Baseline: ARCHCODE results. 4. Outreach: email 3 labs. Phase 2 (1 month): Add 2 model submissions, create leaderboard.md.
top3_proposals.dataset: Existing ARCHCODE data (results/HBB_Unified_Atlas.csv, 8 more loci, Hi-C maps)
top3_proposals.baseline: ARCHCODE v2.17: r=0.28-0.59 (Hi-C), median AUC=0.52 (within-category), 0% cross-locus transfer
top3_proposals.treatment: External model submissions (Akita, Orca, Nucleotide Transformer, future foundation models)
top3_proposals.metrics: Adoption (≥2 submissions / 6mo), reproducibility (≥90%), discovery (≥3 novel findings), citation (≥5 / year), community value (≥5 PI endorsements)
top3_proposals.failure: Zero submissions после 6 months + <50% users can run
top3_proposals.risks: <unknown> Community ignores. <risk> Leaderboard gaming (p-hacking). <risk> Maintenance burden. <risk> Benchmark obsolete.
top3_proposals.safety: [BIOSAFETY CLEARED] Computational only, public data (ClinVar, ENCODE Hi-C), no wet-lab protocols

top3_proposals.formulation: Pre-generating falsification tests для каждой hypothesis перед execution снижает untestable hypotheses с 67% (rule-based baseline) до <20%, увеличивая testability rate до ≥80%.
top3_proposals.known: [VERIFIED] computational_closed_loop.py uses rule-based hypotheses (3 hardcoded). Iteration 2-3 = NOT_TESTED (67% untestable).
top3_proposals.unknown: <hypothesis> Может ли Claude generate falsification tests БЕЗ running code? Или нужен data-aware agent?
top3_proposals.experiment: Prompt: 'Generate 5 hypotheses. For each, design 3 falsification tests (null hypothesis, data availability, baseline comparison).' Rank by testability, implement top-3, run tests, measure confirmation rate.
top3_proposals.dataset: ARCHCODE project files (HBB_Unified_Atlas.csv, Hi-C maps, VEP scores)
top3_proposals.treatment: FalsifyGen: 5 hypotheses, pre-filtered by falsification tests, run top-3
top3_proposals.metrics: Testability rate ≥80% (vs 33%), novelty score ≥0.7/1.0 (LLM-as-Judge), confirmation rate 20-40%, time to falsification <5 min
top3_proposals.risks: <risk> Only 'safe' hypotheses (boring but testable). <unknown> Claude hallucinates tests (suggests unavailable data). <hypothesis> Falsification tests too complex.
